subject.title: fix #95351: [Feature]: Generic JSONL line-parsing hook for CliBackendPlugin (native tool-card support beyond claude-stream-json)

question: Should OpenClaw make `CliBackendPlugin.parseJsonlEvent` and its normalized event union a supported public plugin SDK contract for third-party JSONL CLI backends?
rationale: The code adds an externally consumable plugin API with lasting event and compatibility semantics; tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose whether this public abstraction belongs in the SDK.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in parser contract
options.body: Accept the plugin-owned parsing boundary, contingent on a refreshed head and real third-party CLI proof of the documented display-only semantics.

options.title: Decline this SDK direction
options.body: Keep the current built-in dialect boundaries and close or redirect the capability request until a different plugin API design is approved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in parser contract
recommendation.body: Accept the plugin-owned parsing boundary, contingent on a refreshed head and real third-party CLI proof of the documented display-only semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed contract and can clarify the concrete external CLI requirements, though final API sponsorship belongs with the relevant plugin-SDK decision owner.
